The '''Ossus Farms''' were farms established on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] as part of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]'s [[Ossus Colonization Initiative]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Years later, during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Sith [[Invasion of Ossus|invaded]] Ossus and attempted to destroy the farms to foil the colonization initiative.<ref name="TOR:TLC" />
